_description: Niagara Particle Update module reference. These run every frame per particle. Agent uses this to know what can be updated at runtime.
_source: UE5.6 Epic Documentation - Particle Update Group Reference

Color.vfx_usage: Color over life, dynamic color changes

Scale Color.purpose: Scale initial color RGB and Alpha separately
Scale Color.vfx_usage: Fade out over life, color intensity curves

Scale Sprite Size.purpose: Multiply initial sprite size by curve/value

forces._note: Same modules as Particle Spawn but run every frame. Most forces should be in Update, not Spawn.

Curl Noise Force.vfx_usage: Smoke billowing, fire wavering, magic swirl. MOST IMPORTANT force for organic VFX.

Point Force.purpose: Radial force from point per frame

Wind Force.purpose: Wind with air resistance per frame

Add Velocity from Point.purpose: Add velocity from point each frame

Collision.purpose: Detect collision with world (CPU=raycast, GPU=depth/distance field)
Collision.placement: Immediately BEFORE Solve Forces and Velocity
Collision.vfx_usage: Debris bouncing, sparks hitting ground, rain splashing

Align Particles with Collision Plane.purpose: Align sprite to collision surface over time
Align Particles with Collision Plane.vfx_usage: Blood splats, decals settling on surfaces

Maintain a Set Distance Between Two Poin.purpose: Project point at fixed distance between two positions

Pendulum Setup.purpose: Set up pendulum constraint (requires Pendulum Constraint after)

Orient Mesh to Vector.purpose: Align mesh to vector each frame

Particle State.placement: Usually near bottom of Update stack
Particle State.vfx_usage: REQUIRED in most emitters to remove dead particles

Kill Particles in Volume.vfx_usage: Boundary culling. Must use with Interpolated Spawn or particles flash for 1 frame.

solver._note: Solve modules MUST be present for forces to take effect

Solve Forces and Velocity.purpose: Convert accumulated Physics.Force into velocity and position changes
Solve Forces and Velocity.vfx_usage: REQUIRED if any force module is used

Solve Rotational Forces and Velocity.vfx_usage: REQUIRED if rotational forces are used

Update Beam.purpose: Recalculate beam spline each frame (dynamic endpoints)
Update Beam.vfx_usage: Dynamic beams, lightning between moving objects

Do Once.purpose: Execute only on first true trigger

critical_module_order: 2. Force modules (Curl Noise, Gravity, Drag, Wind, etc.)
3. Solve Forces and Velocity (MUST come after forces)
4. Collision (immediately before or after solver depending on setup)
6. Scale Sprite Size / Scale Mesh Size
9. Particle State (kill when lifetime elapsed — near bottom)
